actions.name: List channels and DMs
actions.description: Lists the channels, private channels, group DMs and direct messages you are in (archived ones left out), 100 a page, each with its id, which the other Slack actions take. A direct message gives the id of the person it is with: Find a person by user names them.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Read recent messages
actions.description: Reads the newest messages of a channel or DM, 15 a page, newest first, each with its ts (Slack's timestamp string), its time in UTC, its author and its text (cut at 4,000 characters). A thread's replies stay out: Read a thread reads them.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Read a thread
actions.description: Reads a thread, the parent message first and then its replies, 15 a page. Give a message link, or the channel and the ts of any message in the thread; a reply's link reads its parent's thread.

link.description: A message link, as Slack's Copy link gives it.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

ts.description: The message's ts, Slack's timestamp string such as 1729951200.000100, from Read recent messages or a send.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Search messages
actions.description: Searches the messages you can read for words, kept together as one phrase, newest first, 20 a page. It can keep to one channel, one author, and messages after or before a day (the days themselves left out). Needs the search permission.

words.description: The words to find, kept together as one phrase.

channel.description: Only this channel: a C or G id.

from.description: Only messages by this person: a U or W id from Find a person.

after.description: Only messages after this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

before.description: Only messages before this day, YYYY-MM-DD.

actions.name: Find a person
actions.description: Finds people in the workspace by exactly one of: email (the address on their profile), name (their full name, any case) or user (an id). It never guesses: it returns everyone who matches, at most 25, or none. Without the permission to read email addresses Slack hides them, so a search by email finds nobody.

name.description: A full name, as Slack shows it.

actions.name: Send to a channel
actions.description: Posts a message to a channel you are in, as you. The text is sent exactly as given: mentions such as <!channel> are escaped and links get no preview, so Slack pings nobody and adds nothing you did not see. A direct message is another kind: use Send a direct message.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

text.description: The message, at most 40,000 characters once escaped.

actions.name: Reply in a thread
actions.description: Replies in a thread of a channel you are in, as you, without sending the reply to the channel. Give a message link, or the channel and the ts of any message in the thread: a reply goes to its thread's parent. The text is escaped and links get no preview, as Send to a channel sends it.

link.description: A message link, as Slack's Copy link gives it.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

ts.description: The message's ts, Slack's timestamp string such as 1729951200.000100, from Read recent messages or a send.

text.description: The reply, at most 40,000 characters once escaped.

actions.name: Send a direct message
actions.description: Sends a direct message to one person, as you: it opens your direct message with them (the same one every time), then posts there. The person is a user id from Find a person; your own id messages yourself. The text is escaped and links get no preview, as Send to a channel sends it.

user.description: The person: a U or W id from Find a person.

text.description: The message, at most 40,000 characters once escaped.

actions.name: Edit my message
actions.description: Replaces the text of one of your own messages in a channel; anyone else's message is refused before anything is sent. It replaces the whole text and removes its attachments, so nothing old stays unseen. The text is escaped, as Send to a channel sends it, at most 4,000 characters.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

ts.description: The message's ts, Slack's timestamp string such as 1729951200.000100, from Read recent messages or a send.

text.description: The new text, at most 4,000 characters once escaped.

actions.name: React
actions.description: Adds or removes your reaction to a message in a channel, by emoji name such as white_check_mark or :thumbsup: (a skin tone such as ::skin-tone-2 may follow); a pasted emoji character is refused. Adding a reaction you already have, or removing one you do not, changes nothing and succeeds.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

ts.description: The message's ts, Slack's timestamp string such as 1729951200.000100, from Read recent messages or a send.

emoji.description: The emoji's name, such as white_check_mark or :white_check_mark:.

actions.name: Schedule or cancel a message
actions.description: Schedules a message to a channel you are in, posted as you at an instant at most 120 days ahead, or cancels one you scheduled there. Cancelling takes the scheduled message's id and its text, as Schedule gave them, and checks Slack still lists that message before it asks. The text is escaped and links get no preview, as Send to a channel sends it.

do.description: schedule takes text and at; cancel takes text and scheduledMessageId.

channel.description: A channel id from List channels and DMs, such as C0123ABCD.

text.description: The message, at most 40,000 characters once escaped.

at.description: When Slack posts it: an RFC 3339 instant with its offset, such as 2026-11-02T09:00:00-05:00.

scheduledMessageId.description: The id Schedule gave, to cancel it.

actions.name: Set my status
actions.description: Sets your Slack status, its text and emoji, until an instant at most 30 days ahead, after which Slack clears it; or clears it now. A status always clears: there is no status without an end. It changes only your own status.

do.description: set takes text, emoji and until; clear takes nothing else.

text.description: The status text, at most 100 characters, sent as given.

emoji.description: The status emoji's name, such as calendar or :calendar:.

until.description: When Slack clears it: an RFC 3339 instant with its offset, at most 30 days ahead.

actions.name: Read a canvas
actions.description: Reads a canvas as Markdown, cut at 50,000 characters with a marker when it is longer. Needs the permission to read canvases.

canvas.description: The canvas id, such as F0123ABCD.
